reason: The text describes Pharaoh (Egypt's elite ruler) issuing an order to the Hebrew midwives to kill all male infants born to Hebrew women. When the midwives refuse and preserve the children, Pharaoh escalates by commanding 'all the people' to throw Hebrew male infants into the Nile River. This represents a systematic attempt by elite authority to cause harm to a subordinate population (the Hebrew people), making the statement directly applicable to the passage.
